package.description: Trusted Python computer-use harness for Windows desktop agents.

en-US.description: Trusted Python computer-use harness for Windows desktop agents.
en-US.name: Agent Desktop Harness
en-US.releaseNotes:
ADH v0.1.7 adds a localized control banner, a softly animated blue border, and physical Esc cancellation. Pressing Esc stops active Python execution and desktop control without treating the cancellation as a retryable worker crash. Synthetic Esc sent by automation does not cancel the task.
- Windows display language selects the banner and shortcut hint, with English fallback.
- The indicator stays click-through, does not steal focus, and remains excluded from captures.
- npm package @xuyuanwu/adh supports Node.js 22 and 24; the native runtime and npm package now both report 0.1.7.
- Local uninstall tooling preserves runtime data while removing ADH agent integration and retained Accio npm installations.
This is an unsigned Windows x64 release. Manual clean-Windows VM validation passed, as confirmed by the maintainer.
Local validation: 187 Python contract tests passed. Native library and interactive overlay checks passed before packaging, including a manual Esc cancellation run.
